title: Understanding Granularity
text: Granularity refers to the level of detail represented by the data. Consider what unique combinations of columns would define a single entry in the DataFrame.

title: Identifying Unique Combinations
text: Look at the columns 'address' and 'item'. How do these columns together define a unique entry in the DataFrame?

hintAnswer: Each unique combination of address and item.
title: Choosing the Correct Granularity
text: Which of the following best describes the granularity of the DataFrame?
choices: Each unique combination of address and item.
